title.zh: Coinbase 获 CFTC 批准设立自有清算机构
title.en: Coinbase Receives CFTC Approval for Its Own Clearinghouse

current_state.zh: Coinbase获得CFTC批准运营其自有USDC原生清算所，使该交易所能够在美国监管下以稳定币抵押品清算其衍生品交易。
current_state.en: Coinbase received CFTC approval to run its own USDC-native clearinghouse, enabling the exchange to clear its derivatives trades with stablecoin-based collateral under US regulation.

updates.title_zh: CFTC批准Coinbase Clearing成为衍生品清算组织
updates.title_en: CFTC Approves Coinbase Clearing as Derivatives Clearing Organization
updates.what_changed_zh: CFTC已批准Coinbase Clearing注册为衍生品清算组织，允许Coinbase在联邦监管下清算衍生品交易，并加深了美国受监管的加密衍生品基础设施。
updates.what_changed_en: The CFTC has approved Coinbase Clearing as a registered Derivatives Clearing Organization, allowing Coinbase to clear derivatives trades under federal oversight and deepening regulated crypto derivatives infrastructure in the US.
updates.current_state_zh: CFTC已批准Coinbase Clearing注册为衍生品清算组织，允许Coinbase在联邦监管下清算衍生品交易，并加深了美国受监管的加密衍生品基础设施。
updates.current_state_en: The CFTC has approved Coinbase Clearing as a registered Derivatives Clearing Organization, allowing Coinbase to clear derivatives trades under federal oversight and deepening regulated crypto derivatives infrastructure in the US.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The CFTC has approved Coinbase Clearing as a registered Derivatives Clearing Organization, allowing Coinbase to clear derivatives trades under federal oversight and deepening regulated crypto derivatives infrastructure in the US.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase赢得CFTC批准，补齐完整的美国加密衍生品体系
updates.title_en: Coinbase Wins CFTC Approval, Completing Full U.S. Crypto Derivatives Stack
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase获得CFTC批准，完善其美国加密衍生品产品线，为该交易所补齐了完整的衍生品体系。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase received CFTC approval to round out its U.S. crypto derivatives offering, completing a full derivatives stack for the exchange.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase刚刚完成其美国衍生品体系，但其最大赌注仍在该体系之外
updates.title_en: Coinbase just completed its US derivatives stack but its biggest bet still sits outside it
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase为Coinbase Clearing LLC取得CFTC注册，成为衍生品清算组织，完成其美国经纪-交易所-清算垂直整合体系，但其计划中的股票永续合约仍需另行获批，初期将依赖外部清算。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase secured CFTC registration for Coinbase Clearing LLC as a derivatives clearing organization, completing its vertically integrated US brokerage-exchange-clearing stack while its planned stock perpetuals still await separate approval and will initially rely on external clearing.
